test_title: PYST 135: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 27 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
A @ B means ‘A is the spouse of B’.

A & B means ‘A is the father of B’.

A # B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

A % B means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If H @ V & K % Q # F, then how is H related to F?

H @ V & K % Q # F → H is spouse of V, V is father of K, K is sister of Q, Q is mother of F.

Clearly, H is maternal grandmother of F.

Hence, ‘**Maternal grandmother**’ is the correct answer.
